_readme: Your own text, appended to the image prompt for that scene. Empty = default prompt only.
scenes: act_<serviceId> for each service, pov (every Sam/POV scene), bath, mishap (shower / walk-in), solo (a lady alone in her room at max lust).
clothing: how each clothing state is described. {outfit} and {underwear} are filled in from her wardrobe; commando becomes "bare skin, nothing underneath". nude falls back to partial while empty.
clothing.aside / aside_commando: used for Modest ladies during services, when her clothes are pulled aside instead of taken off.

clothing.partial: wearing {outfit}, partially undressed, clothes loosened and slipping off to show {underwear}
clothing.aside: still wearing {outfit}, her clothes pulled aside rather than taken off, {underwear} pushed aside
clothing.aside_commando: still wearing {outfit}, her clothes pulled aside rather than taken off, nothing underneath
